extracted.intended_audience: Investigators and institutional grant administrators preparing NIH R01 (PA-20-185) budgets, budget justifications, and PHS 398 research plan/cover page supplement materials
extracted.subtask_short: NIH R01 budget and PHS398 forms
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing the Research & Related Budget (Sections A–K), the Budget Justification, and required PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement / Research Plan attachments for an NIH R01 (including subaward/consortium entries).

rubrics_metrics.name: Senior/Key Person budget entries (Section A)
rubrics_metrics.description: A. Senior/Key Person — Start Date, End Date, Budget Period; fields for Prefix, First/Middle/Last Name, Suffix, Project Role, Base Salary, Calendar/Academic/Summer Months, Requested Salary ($), Fringe Benefits ($), Funds Requested ($).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enter each senior/key person's appointment dates, percent/time in months (calendar/academic/summer), salary, benefits, and total funds requested. Include total funds requested for all Senior/Key Persons in the attached file.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other Personnel budget entries (Section B)
rubrics_metrics.description: B. Other Personnel — Number of Personnel; Project Role; Calendar Months, Academic Months, Summer Months; Requested Salary ($); Fringe Benefits; Funds Requested ($). Categories listed: Post Doctoral Associates, Graduate Students, Undergraduate Students, Secretarial/Clerical, Senior Research Assistant, Research Assistant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List all other personnel by role with months of effort, requested salary and fringe, and funds requested. Provide totals (Total Number Other Personnel; Total Salary, Wages and Fringe Benefits (A+B)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Equipment reporting (Section C)
rubrics_metrics.description: C. Equipment Description — 'List items and dollar amount for each item exceeding $' and provide Equipment Item and Funds Requested ($); Total funds requested for all equipment listed in the attached file.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report each equipment item that exceeds the applicable threshold (enter dollar amount). Provide an attachment listing all equipment, total equipment funds, and filename/mime type for the attachment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Travel costs (Section D)
rubrics_metrics.description: D. Travel — Funds Requested ($) with separate lines for 1. Domestic Travel Costs (Incl. Canada, Mexico, and U.S. Possessions) and 2. Foreign Travel Costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Separate domestic and foreign travel costs. Include detailed estimates for airfare, per diem, lodging and meeting fees as part of the Budget Justification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Participant/Trainee Support Costs (Section E)
rubrics_metrics.description: E. Participant/Trainee Support Costs — categories: 1. Tuition/Fees/Health Insurance; 2. Stipends; 3. Travel; 4. Subsistence; 5. Other; plus Number of Participants/Trainees and Total Participant Trainee Support Costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If requesting participant/trainee support, itemize amounts for tuition/fees/insurance, stipends, travel, subsistence and other costs and report the number of participants/trainees and totals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other Direct Costs categories (Section F)
rubrics_metrics.description: F. Other Direct Costs — list includes: 1. Materials and Supplies; 2. Publication Costs; 3. Consultant Services; 4. ADP/Computer Services; 5. Subawards/Consortium/Contractual Costs; 6. Equipment or Facility Rental/User Fees; 7. Alterations and Renovations; 8. Subject Payments; 9. Biostat CORE.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Itemize other direct cost categories with amounts and provide justification in the Budget Justification. Include subaward/consortium costs under appropriate line items and attach supporting files as needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct costs subtotal (Section G)
rubrics_metrics.description: G. Direct Costs — Total Direct Costs (A thru F).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compute and report the total direct costs summing Sections A–F for the budget period. Provide cumulative totals across budget periods in the Cumulative Budget table.

rubrics_metrics.name: Indirect Costs reporting (Section H)
rubrics_metrics.description: H. Indirect Costs — Indirect Cost Type (e.g., MTDC), Indirect Cost Rate (%), Indirect Cost Base ($), Funds Requested ($); Cognizant Federal Agency (Agency Name, POC Name, and POC Phone Number).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report the applicable indirect cost rate and base (e.g., MTDC), calculate funds requested for indirect costs, and identify the cognizant federal agency and contact. Ensure institutional rates and bases comply with federal requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Totals and Fee (Sections I, J, K)
rubrics_metrics.description: I. Total Direct and Indirect Costs — Funds Requested ($); J. Fee — Funds Requested ($); K. Total Costs and Fee — Funds Requested ($).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compute total direct and indirect institutional costs, include any allowable fee, and report the total costs and fee (I + J). Ensure calculations are transparent and supported by the Budget Justification and attachments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Justification attachment requirement (Section L)
rubrics_metrics.description: L. Budget Justification — File Name: VUMC_Budget_Just.pdf (mime type: application/pdf).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a detailed budget justification file explaining personnel effort, non-labor supplies, core fees, travel estimates, subject reimbursement, and other expenses tied to specific aims and timeline. Attach the file and specify mime type.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equipment and supply justification (Budget Justification content)
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe funds requested to support experiments (e.g., Luminex multiplex IgG detection, complement binding assays, neutrophil phagocytosis assays, cytotoxicity assays), list needed reagents and supplies (MagPlex microspheres, Sulfo-NHS, phlebotomy supplies, ELISA reagents, cell culture materials, chemicals for gel electrophoresis), and specify timing (Years 1–5).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tie non-labor budget items to specific aims and experimental needs; identify major one-time and recurring expenses and their distribution across budget years. Indicate existing equipment availability when relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personnel justification (Budget Justification content)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide biographical/role descriptions for personnel (e.g., qualifications, past experience), specify years and calendar months of effort (e.g., Years 1–5: 2.4 calendar months), percent research effort, specific responsibilities (oversight, enrollment, experiments, data analysis, manuscript preparation).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each named person, justify the requested effort by describing role, relevant expertise, and how effort supports the specific aims. Include percent effort (months), and note primary duties and transitions of effort over the award.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human subject reimbursement justification
rubrics_metrics.description: Estimate number of subjects per year (e.g., 20 subjects per year) and provide reimbursement per subject and total per year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide rationale and amounts for participant compensation tied to IRB-approved protocols. Show annual estimates and how totals were calculated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Core and fee-supported resource documentation (e.g., Biostatistics Collaboration Center)
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe core resource (BCC) services, billing approach (revenue-neutral, billed as percentage of salary and fringe), scientific resource fee per 100% annual FTE, and compliance with federal/state regulations including Uniform Administrative Requirements, Cost Principles, and Audit Requirements for Federal Awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If using institutional cores, document the nature of the resource, billing mechanism, rates and justification, compliance posture, and any additional scientific resource fees. Attach institutional documentation if required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Travel cost detail and justification
rubrics_metrics.description: Funds requested to support transportation, lodging, and meeting fees for PIs to present at two national scientific meetings each year; cost estimates include airfare ($/day for 3 days per trip) and daily expenses ($/day for 3 days per trip), hotel per trip, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide per-trip and per-person travel cost breakdowns and justify the meeting frequency and necessity relative to project aims. Include annual totals across project years.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cumulative Budget reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: RESEARCH & RELATED BUDGET - Cumulative Budget — report totals for Sections A–F, Section G Direct Costs (A thru F), Section H Indirect Costs, Section I Total Direct and Indirect Costs, Section J Fee, Section K Total Costs and Fee across budget periods and totals ($).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide cumulative totals across all budget periods and ensure each line item and section aggregates correctly. Use the provided tables to display totals per budget period and overall totals.

rubrics_metrics.name: NIH policy on excluding consortium/contractual F&A from direct cost limits
rubrics_metrics.description: NIH policy (NOT-OD-05-004) allows applicants to exclude consortium/contractual F&A costs when determining if an application falls at or beneath any applicable direct cost limit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When an FOA specifies a direct cost limit, applicants may remove consortium/contractual F&A from the calculation to determine whether the application is within the limit. Use the provided table to determine Total Direct Costs less Consortium F&A by budget period.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Vertebrate Animals section requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Are vertebrate animals euthanized? If 'Yes' — Is the method consistent with American Veterinary Medical Association (AVMA) guidelines? If 'No' to AVMA guidelines, describe method and provide scientific justification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Answer euthanasia questions and, if deviating from AVMA guidelines, provide the method description and scientific justification in the Vertebrate Animals attachment.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Program Income reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Program Income Section — If program income is anticipated, use the format to reflect the amount and source(s) by Budget Period (Anticipated Amount ($), Source(s)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only complete this section if program income is expected; list amounts and sources for each budget period. Otherwise leave blank.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human embryonic stem cell (hESC) documentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Human Embryonic Stem Cells Section — Does the proposed project involve human embryonic stem cells? If yes, list registration number(s) of specific cell line(s) from the NIH registry or check that one from the registry will be used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide registry numbers for the specific hESC line(s) or indicate that a registered line will be used; follow NIH hESC policies and reference the registry URL.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human fetal tissue (HFT) documentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Human Fetal Tissue Section — Does the proposed project involve human fetal tissue obtained from elective abortions? If 'yes' then provide the HFT Compliance Assurance and the HFT Sample IRB Consent Form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If HFT is involved, attach required compliance assurance and IRB consent form templates/documentation as specified by NIH guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventions and Patents reporting (renewal applications)
rubrics_metrics.description: Inventions and Patents Section (Renewal applications) — Indicate Yes/No for inventions and patents; if 'Yes' then indicate whether previously reported (Yes/No).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For renewal applications, report inventions/patents resulting from the project and whether they have been previously reported to NIH.

rubrics_metrics.name: Change of Investigator / Change of Institution reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Change of Investigator/Change of Institution Section — provide information for Change of Project Director/Principal Investigator (name of former PD/PI) and Change of Grantee Institution (name of former institution).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When proposing a change of PD/PI or grantee institution, provide the requested identifying information and follow NIH procedures for approvals and notifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required Research Plan attachments (PHS 398 Research Plan)
rubrics_metrics.description: Research Plan Section required attachments: 1. Specific Aims; 2. Research Strategy; 3. Progress Report Publication List; Other Research Plan Section: 5. Vertebrate Animals; 6. Select Agent Research; 7. Multiple PD/PI Leadership Plan; 8. Consortium/Contractual Arrangements; 9. Letters of Support; 10. Resource Sharing Plan(s); 11. Other Plan(s) (Data Management Sharing Plan); 12. Authentication of Key Biological and/or Chemical Resources; 13. Appendix.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include and attach each listed Research Plan component as separate files with appropriate filenames. Ensure each attachment addresses the relevant policies (e.g., authentication, resource sharing, leadership plan) and follows page limits and FOA-specific instructions.
